# The policy for each clang-tidy check that reports in the gate, shown under the check on the run page.
# One line per check: "<check>: <policy>". Read by .github/scripts/gate_summary.py.
bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters: Accepted. Fixing one means changing a public constructor or setter, and eight are generated by the lttng macros. Known ones stay in the baseline; a new one is to be looked at before it is added.
bugprone-narrowing-conversions: Fixed with an explicit static_cast in the core and cl_nav2z. The ones left are in the cl_px4_mr pattern behaviors, at the float fields of the PX4 messages, and have not been swept; a new one is to be fixed.
bugprone-misplaced-widening-cast: Not swept. These are the point counts in the cl_px4_mr pattern generators, small integers far from overflow; a new one is to be fixed.
cppcoreguidelines-pro-type-member-init: Enforced: a new one is to be fixed. The ones in the baseline are false positives, a member assigned in the constructor body or written before it is read.
bugprone-exception-escape: Accepted for main(): an exception that reaches it ends the node, which is the intended outcome.
bugprone-integer-division: Accepted where listed: the division is the intended leg number of the square spiral. A new one is to be read.
bugprone-reserved-identifier: Accepted for the lttng header guard, whose name the lttng macros require. A new one is to be fixed.
clang-analyzer-core.CallAndMessage: False positive in signal_detector.cpp, kept in the baseline. A new one is to be read as a possible defect.
bugprone-unused-return-value: False positive in http_session.cpp: shutdown() also writes its result to the error code passed in, which the next line checks. A new one is to be read.
cppcoreguidelines-owning-memory: MISRA C++:2023 rule 21.6.2, added 2026-11-19; the 27 it gave then were fixed by 2026-11-20 and the baseline holds none. A new one is to be fixed: an event is created with smacc2::makeEvent, anything else with make_shared, make_unique or an owning member.
cppcoreguidelines-no-malloc: MISRA C++:2023 rule 21.6.2. The one it gave, the free() of the string abi::__cxa_demangle returns in introspection.hpp, is now the deleter of a unique_ptr and the baseline holds none. A new one is to be fixed.
